grip.note: held upright like the sun staff

note: The Harpooner's harpoon (Tidecallers), hand-authored at 1 texel a px: a salt-grey driftwood shaft, a sea-blue grip and band, a hemp coil with a trailing line and a barbed iron head; held upright. Tier III: a bronze collar, a sea-blue coil and a longer steel head and hooks; a bronze head set with pearl and a sea-blue collar.
